pages.title: Explosive Arrow
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Bows, Crossbows$(br2)§lEffect: §r Arrows trigger a small explosion on hit that does not destroy terrain; higher levels increase blast radius and damage. Conflicts with Chain Arrow.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
